_what: DB-12's "audit coverage map" (docs/plans/core-database-and-rls-workstream-th.md:795), as data: one or more rows per SEC-009 class; a row for each audited action OB-005 (security/admin/external actions), PDPA-007, PDPA-008, BIL-013, OPS-002, OPS-006 and ERD §8, §10 and §11 name; and the actions the work package already records as owed to batch 141's audit coverage. It is complete against those sources ONLY: whether another domain document names a further audited action is owed on WP-0A-DB-00 open_blockers[191] (5), and the batch 141 prep review round (C0 G1, A1 R2) is where the rows after the first nine came from. For each, the table(s) the action changes, the §8 cell it is, the producer that would write its audit row, and the open blocker that holds it. It is a MAP OF WHAT IS OWED, not a claim that anything is covered: nothing in this repository can write an audit row today (WP-0A-DB-00 open_blockers[21]).
_written_by: The batch 141 preparation draft (A0 /claude/a0_atlas drafting subagent, 2026-10-03). No migration. It approves nothing and decides none of the questions it names.

_shape.id: unique, dotted, stable; a renamed row is a new row
_shape.action: the action in words, quoted or paraphrased from its source
_shape.source: where the obligation to audit it is written: SEC-009, OB-005, or an open blocker
_shape.category: one of CTR-AUD-001's six action categories, or null when no category fits -- then category_note says why, and that is a finding, not a choice
_shape.tables: schema-qualified tables the action changes, each created by a migration in db/foundation/migrations/; empty only with tables_note
_shape.producer_path: "UNDECIDED" until the row's producer has LANDED; then "command" or "worker". Q141-a was answered (B, 2026-10-04) and RFC-2026-026 approved (2026-10-05), so trigger is no longer a value; batch 141 (migration 172) set the first two rows to command
_shape.producer_decision: the question or RFC that decides producer_path: Q141-a while UNDECIDED, RFC-2026-026 once a producer has landed
_shape.section8_cell: the §8 row(s) this action is, each quoted exactly as its first column appears in docs/sprint-0a/sprint-0a-core-erd-rls-retention-th.md §8.1-§8.4, or null with section8_note
_shape.blockers: one or more { index, line, quote }: index into work-packages/WP-0A-DB-00.json open_blockers, its line in that file today, and a phrase the blocker text contains, so a renumbered list fails by name instead of pointing at the wrong blocker
_shape.producer: only on a row whose producer_path is command (RFC-2026-026 §8.1/4): the producer function(s), as schema.name(argument types) -- read by scripts/db/audit-producer-rule.mjs as the pinned producer set of RFC-2026-026 §8.1/1 (a)

_undecided: producer_path was UNDECIDED on every row until batch 141. Q141-a (Owner + A1) asked whether an audit row is produced by (A) a database trigger whose SECURITY DEFINER function is owned by a non-request-path role, (B) the application command or worker only, or (C) a hybrid; it was answered (B) on 2026-10-04 and RFC-2026-026 approved on 2026-10-05. Batch 141 (migration 172) landed the first command producer, the §11.4 closing command, and its two rows name it; every other row stays UNDECIDED until its command or job lands, which names its producer in the same diff (RFC-2026-026 §8.1/4, owed row by row).
